_note: Game content per world-map location (positions live in the Tiled world map). map = public/assets/maps/<map>.json, entered when the party walks onto the location. intro = message shown on entering. sight = how many squares the party sees on the overhead map (default: towns 5, dungeons 1). wander = random encounters per step inside (chance, difficulty, share, dialogs — rules/wandering.ts). Places inside a location (not on the world map) have name, style (town|cave|ruins|interior) and parent = where you come out (location id, square, facing).

hollow-cave.intro: You duck under the low rock and into the cool dark of the cave.

old-keep.intro: You climb over a fallen gate into the ruins of the old keep.

millbrook.intro: Millbrook's market road is busy with carts and gossip.

fenwick.intro: Fenwick smells of fish, smoke and river mud.

brewery-interior.name: Odo's Brewery
brewery-interior.intro: Warm, damp air thick with the smell of mash. Copper vats gleam in the half dark.

shrine-of-the-dawn.name: Shrine of the Dawn
shrine-of-the-dawn.intro: Cold air and a sour animal stink. Something skitters away from the door.
